posts.name: Dandolo
posts.cooked:
Powerhound_2000:

I’m surprised that didn’t have more losses as I find five hero teams have the hardest time against Dreamer and Tomb of Anubis is not friendly.

Yeah Tomb of Anubis made this a rough round. Almost all the teams that won just squeaked by.

Freedom 5: Legacy and Wraith incapacitated.
Prime Wardens: Fanatic incapacitated on the front side. This was the easiest fight though as I focused stalling on her front side so I could draw Cleansing Downpour and heal everyone to full before flipping her. The other 4 heroes ended the game at Max HP after a fight that lasted around 1.5 hours.
Dark Watch: Nightmist was last hero standing. Once she flipped I hid in Mist Form until the environment took out her Projections.
Void Guard: A really rough start. All heroes were quickly in single digits and almost lost early. However, Dr. Medico eventually was able to stabilize everyone else’s HP and Mainstay was able to tank for Medico well enough to keep him active.
Alternative Reality: Omnitron-x was the only hero standing at 2 HP.
Space: Mainstay was the only hero standing. He ended the game at 5 HP but was down to 1 HP at one point.
